_comment: SLEEPI research group — INCOMPLETE. This config currently produces an empty list.
The original plan was to seed it with a PubMed `SLEEPI[au]` search plus a set of
pinned PMIDs/DOIs. The PubMed search does not work: `SLEEPI[au]` returns 0 results
(PubMed reports the phrase as not found), and so do `SLEEPI[cn]` and `SLEEPI[ir]`.
The group is not registered in PubMed as a collective/corporate author, so there is
no author-field query that can find its output (verified against the live E-utilities
A free-text `SLEEPI` search returns 5 records, none of them this group's — they are
matches on the unrelated SLEEP-I trial and on incidental text. It is therefore not a
usable seed either.
TO COMPLETE THIS FILE, the owner needs to supply one of:
(a) the PMIDs and/or DOIs of the group's publications, as `include` entries in the
form "pmid:12345678" / "doi:10.1136/bmj.n71"; and/or
(b) the ORCID iDs of the group members, as `seeds.orcid`; and/or
(c) a PubMed query that actually retrieves the group's work, e.g. a narrowed
author-plus-affiliation search, as `seeds.pubmed`.
No identifiers have been guessed or filled in. An empty list is recoverable; a list
of fabricated identifiers attributed to a research group is not.
This `_comment` key is not part of ListConfig. `normalizeConfig()` in
src/core/config.ts rebuilds the config from known keys only, so it is ignored at
runtime and never reaches the rendered list.
